content: Symbolic Name Reference properties An EcucAbstract- InternalReferenceDef with the attribute requiresSymbolicNameValue set to true is used to establish the relationship between the user of a symbolic name and the provider of a symbolic name. The object defining the EcucAbstractInternal- ReferenceDef is the user and the destination of the reference is the provider of the symbolic name.
